description: Calculate dividend CIT (22/78 from 2025-01-01; earlier dates date-gated) and create draft journal entries. Only the NET dividend debits retained earnings; the CIT books as income-tax expense (P&L 'Tulumaks', Kulud 8900–8999). ÄS § 157 lg 1 starts from the owner's APPROVED annual report: pass approved_report_year and, from that report's balance sheet, approved_retained_earnings = line 'Eelmiste perioodide jaotamata kasum (kahjum)' and approved_profit_for_year = line 'Aruandeaasta kasum (kahjum)'. Ask the owner or read them from the approved report; never compute them from the books. The tool cross-checks them against the ledger at that year end (a difference holds the dividend) and subtracts every equity distribution booked since, drafts and later dates included. Hard-blocks a net dividend above that, or a gross (net + CIT) that would push net assets below share capital + restricted reserves (lg 2, unconfirmed and later journals reserved), unless force=true; force never lifts a hold or a ledger imbalance. Reports max_net_dividend. One journal per shareholder+date: identical retry → duplicate, different amount → dividend_key_conflict. Attach the profit-distribution decision to the journal with attach_document. Previews by default (dry_run=true), returning a single-use plan_handle: after explicit user approval, call with identical inputs, dry_run=false and that handle. Changed inputs or proposed journal refuse with plan_drift; nothing is written.

approved_profit_for_year.description: Required. EUR, may be negative: balance-sheet line 'Aruandeaasta kasum (kahjum)' of that approved report. From the owner or the report, never computed.

approved_report_year.description: Required. Financial year of the last APPROVED annual report: the dividend year − 1, or − 2 when last year's report is not approved yet.

approved_retained_earnings.description: Required. EUR, may be negative: balance-sheet line 'Eelmiste perioodide jaotamata kasum (kahjum)' of that approved report. From the owner or the report, never computed.

dry_run.description: Preview calculation, legality checks, and postings without creating a journal (default true). Set false only after the user explicitly approves the previewed journal.

force.description: Book even if the ÄS § 157 lg 1 or lg 2 amount check fails (only alongside e.g. a capital reduction). Never overrides a hold (approved-report mismatch, unverified amounts, history or draft holds, invalid targets) or a ledger-imbalance block. Default false.

income_tax_expense_account.description: Income-tax expense account debited with the CIT — the P&L 'Tulumaks' line, Kulud 8900–8999 (default: lowest active such account, else 8900)

ledger_difference_acknowledged.description: Only after the owner confirmed the approved figures against the report: the reported difference (approved − ledger at the report year end), to the cent. Never copy the displayed difference without that check.

plan_handle.description: Required with dry_run=false: single-use handle from the approved preview, with the same inputs

restricted_reserve_accounts.description: Accounts whose balances ÄS §157(2) makes non-distributable (net assets must stay above share capital + these reserves). Default: auto-detect every 'Kohustuslik reservkapital' account (active or inactive) AND always the standard reserve number 2940, so a funded-but-renamed 2940 is never missed; only booked balances raise the floor, so unfunded accounts add nothing. If your chart has REPURPOSED 2940 to a distributable reserve, pass this list explicitly (e.g. [] for no floor, or your real reserve account) to override the 2940 default. Explicit accounts need only exist (inactive OK).

retained_earnings_account.description: Retained earnings account debited with the NET dividend (default: auto-detect 'jaotamata kasum', standard 2960). Must be a retained-earnings or result account by name, number or the configured result account

share_capital_account.description: Share capital account for ÄS §157 net-assets check (default: auto-detect 'Osakapital', standard 2900). Must carry the share-capital name or be 2900

tax_payable_account.description: Dividend income-tax payable (liability) account (default: auto-detect 'Dividenditulumaksu võlg', standard 2656)
